description: Ethereum MEV-Boost delivered blocks from the Flashbots relay: proposer payment in ETH (block value), transaction count, gas used vs limit, and builder pubkeys with block counts. Covers the newest blocks only (1 to 50). Sandwich volume is not in this source and is not reported. Related tools on this server, for a different need: crypto_subtensor_block_metrics when you need Per-block extrinsic and event counts for the last N blocks; crypto_btc_block when you need Detailed Bitcoin block summary by height or hash. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

limit.description: How many of the newest delivered blocks, 1 to 50 (default 10)

name: crypto_mev_block_analytics
title: Ethereum MEV-Boost delivered blocks from the Flashbots
